restoration.defect: CAP-07.S01.NATIVE-F01: an unstarted guided workflow and an outstanding supporting-tool handoff were both described as expired. Reopening the primary page could not start the workflow or restore a missing return.
restoration.expectedBehavior: Distinguish not-started and pending states. Direct supporting-tool users to the existing Project Home explicit Start action, without a Home self-loop or automatic start. Publish a return only for the exact current request, project, intent, selection, profile, stage and workspace. Deny obsolete success, error and cleanup across navigation and project replacement. Preserve shared controls, keyboard focus, both themes and unchanged reference authority.

focusedEvidence.scope: Development check before candidate commit: three assembled-application tests passed, including explicit start and exact return, both themes, deferred success/rejection, newer-request ownership, same-fixture close/reopen and current-request failure. The original two regression cases first failed against unchanged product behavior. Fixture transport is not native proof; fresh commit-bound checks and native replay are required separately.
